heads.basics: Who the character is, and how long ago the Embrace was.
heads.clan: The blood you were Embraced into: three disciplines that come easily, a bane and a compulsion.
heads.attributes: Click the dots. One attribute at 4, three at 3, four at 2 and one at 1.
heads.skills: Pick a distribution, then click the dots. Academics, Craft, Performance and Science need a specialty; one more specialty is free.
heads.disciplines: One clan discipline at 2 dots, another at 1, and one power for each dot.
heads.predator: How you hunt. It gives a specialty, a discipline dot and some advantages or flaws.
heads.advantages: Spend 7 points on merits and backgrounds and take at least 2 points of flaws.
heads.beliefs: 1 to 3 Convictions, each tied to a mortal Touchstone, plus an Ambition and a Desire.
heads.review: Everything at once. Fix what is missing, then finish.

choicesLeft.one: {count} choice left — the checklist shows where.
choicesLeft.other: {count} choices left — the checklist shows where.

builder.name: Name
builder.ageHelp: sets Blood Potency, starting XP and generation
builder.placementsHelp: click a dot to set it, the same dot again to clear
builder.distributionHelp: how wide or deep your training is
builder.skillsHelp: click a skill name to set its specialty in the right column
builder.chooseClanFirst: Choose a clan first: it decides which disciplines come easily.
builder.thinBloodNoDisciplines: Thin-bloods start with no disciplines. Take the Thin-blood Alchemist merit (Advantages step) to brew formulas instead.
builder.freeRitualHelp: Blood Sorcery starts with one level-1 ritual
builder.budgetMeritsHint: Spend exactly 7 points (9 for an ancilla). Click a name to read it in the right column.
builder.budgetFlawsHint: Take at least 2 points (4 for an ancilla). More flaws are allowed.
builder.budgetCoterieHint: Optional. Points given to your coterie (up to 7) come from the same advantage points; with one dot from every member they pay for the domain and shared backgrounds, set on the sheet.
builder.budgetLoreHint: Optional. Paid from the same advantage points: a level-3 entry costs 3. Some are for one clan only. Hover a dot to see its entry.
builder.loreEntryHelp: · each dot is its own entry, costing its level in points
builder.thinBloodPicksHelp: 1 to 3 merits, the same number of flaws
builder.alchemyMethodHelp: the attribute you distill with; the formula is picked on the Disciplines step
builder.convictionPlaceholder: e.g. Never destroy a work of art.
builder.convictionHelp: A moral line your character won't cross, even as a monster. Breaking it costs Humanity.
builder.touchstoneHelp: A living mortal who embodies that conviction. Losing them shakes your Humanity.
builder.ambitionPlaceholder: e.g. A seat at the Prince's table
builder.desireOptional: Optional; it changes from session to session.

explain.title: What this choice means
explain.empty: Click any option, trait or power to read what it does and what it changes.

sheet.saveFailed: That change could not be saved.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.raiseHint: Open a discipline to raise it with XP or learn a power for a new dot.
sheet.outOfClanNote: Out-of-clan: learning it calls for a taste of the blood of someone who has it. The Storyteller decides.
sheet.resonanceNote: Raising it calls for drinking {resonance} blood{match}. A reminder, not a block.
sheet.distillMethod: Method: {method}. One Rouse Check, then roll; 2, 4 or 6 successes brew a weak, normal or strong dose.
sheet.flawsHint: Flaws come from creation and the Storyteller, not from XP
sheet.addAdvantageLead: Backgrounds are what you have; merits are traits. Buying the first dot spends XP right away.
sheet.loreLead: Each dot is its own entry, bought separately: it doesn't give the lower ones. The Storyteller decides which loresheets the chronicle allows.
sheet.tenetsHelp: The rules everyone in it keeps.
sheet.boonsHelp: Who owes the coterie, and whom it owes.

poolExplain.one: One dot from you, {contribution} you gave at creation, and what the others gave:
poolExplain.other: One dot from each of the {count} members, {contribution} you gave at creation, and what the others gave:

sheet.descriptionHelp: The streets, the buildings, the feeding grounds.
sheet.domainResonanceHelp: The emotion most blood there carries.
sheet.frenzyLead: When the Beast pushes to take over: roll current Willpower plus a third of Humanity, no Hunger dice. Fail and you frenzy.
sheet.toRollLog: The result goes to the roll log
sheet.fullTrackHint: When the track is full, new Superficial damage becomes Aggravated
sheet.rouseHint: 6 or more passes; anything else raises Hunger by one
sheet.remorseHint: End of session: one die per empty, unstained box. Any success keeps Humanity; none loses a dot. Stains clear.
sheet.experienceLead: Earn XP each session and story, then spend it one dot at a time from any trait. Undo the latest spend on a trait to refund it.
sheet.xpHint: Usually 1 per session and 1 per finished story — the Storyteller's call
sheet.laterSpendFirst: A later spend on the same trait comes first

dice.emptyPool: Click a rating on the sheet to add it.
